case_metadata.title: Jharia Coal Basin Chronic Subsurface Mine Fire
case_metadata.description: Demonstrates persistent 180-day chronic thermal recurrence (12-19 MW) in bare mining terrain. Correctly classified as MINE_HEAT without false alarm.
